key.ironsarms.mana_draw: Store mana in held gun (Mana Draw)
enchantment.ironsarms.conductive.desc: Lets a gun take a spell from a scroll in the Arcane Anvil.
enchantment.ironsarms.mana_draw.desc: Lets an imbued gun store mana from your mana bar and pay for spell shots from it. Higher levels store more and waste less.
